item.title: Choosing a Claude Model: Start on Opus 5.5 at Medium, Tune Effort Before You Switch
item.description: A practical breakdown of the four current Claude models: what each costs, which tasks it fits, why self-verification and effort come before a model switch, how to mix models with subagents, and which API settings break when you migrate.

item.title: [Claude FDE 1/6] How an FDE Differs from a Typical AI Developer: The 4D Framework and Setting Limits
item.description: A breakdown of the four core modules in Anthropic’s Claude FDE curriculum: setting realistic model boundaries, applying the 4D AI Fluency framework, choosing platform surfaces, and matching Claude models to workloads.
